items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cedric Williams was the piano player.

ctx.x: Black. Cedric Williams was the piano player. He was my age and from Kansas City at the time, who, at that time when he came from Kansas City, he was in some weird way. He had a habit. I had never seen that. I didn’t know nothing about that. One day he asked me to help him . . .
